mentions.name: NativePHP
mentions.description: A PHP library that lets PHP developers build native mobile apps without learning new languages or skills, scaffolding an app with just a few commands. The first fully open source version of the Mobile package is planned for release this month, and over 2,000 licenses have been sold since May, including 1,000 given away to the African PHP community.
mentions.problem: PHP developers face a barrier to entering mobile app development because it normally requires learning new languages and skills.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A two-man team, we're enabling PHP developers to get into mobile app development as easily as possible - no need to learn new languages, no new skills, just a few commands and away you go.

NativePHP is the library.
